Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Rate quote will be considered as inclusive of direct, indirect and local tax. No GST/other tax will be charged in addition quote d price. • The rate contract of the successful bidder will be valid for the one financial year. • Awarded vendor will have to deliver specified quantity of goods to the concerned colleges / institutions i n the district without any additional transportation cost, installation charges, loading and unloading charge s, out of pocket expenses etc. • The supplied products should not be defective. Replacement will be provided for defective/non-operating products at no extra cost to the seller. • If any dispute arising out the bid or contract signed by the buyer the successful bidder or any other bidde rs / bidder participating in this procurement process shall be subject to the jurisdiction of district court. • TDS or any applied Tax should be deducted as per norms set up by Governments of India/ Bihar. • The Buyer / Chairman District Purchase Committee reserves the right to reject this bid partially / fully wit hout assigning any reason. . 4.
